faqs.q: Sec. 38-91. - Maximum permissible continuous sound pressure levels—General.
faqs.a:
It shall be unlawful for any person to operate or cause or permit to be operated any
               stationary source of noise which creates a sound pressure level that exceeds the limits
               set forth in Table I for more than 90 percent of any measurement period. This measurement
               shall not be less than ten minutes when measured at the property boundary or at any
               point within the property affected by the noise.
